subject: Post-demo: third-party snapshot + security questionnaire (next steps)
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Alex James <alex.james@medexus.com>, security@medexus.com
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 22 Mar 2028 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: third-party snapshot + security questionnaire (next steps)

Hi Alex / Medexus security team —

Thanks again for the demo today — great conversation and helpful context on your data residency and PHI handling needs. Per our call, I wanted to capture the immediate security/compliance items you asked us to kick off so your Legal and Security teams can start their review: 

1) SOC 2 evidence: current status + roadmap (Type II, if applicable)
2) DPA / data residency language and any suggested redlines
3) Initial third-party/subprocessor roster (cloud providers, analytics, monitoring, CDNs) — CSV preferred
4) High-level data flow diagram showing where tokens/PII touch Redwood services and our recommended data minimization controls
5) Clarify whether HIPAA BAAs or specific logging retention need to be spelled out

Attached: redwood_security_profile.pdf (concise profile), sq_kickoff_template.docx (format we can use to capture Medexus questions). I also dropped a blank CSV template in the Drive link if you'd prefer to complete that instead of the attachments.

Requested next steps / owners: 
- Medexus: send back (a) subprocessor roster CSV, (b) any DPA redlines, (c) timeline for Legal review (we heard ~2 weeks on the call)
- Redwood: we will pull our latest SOC 2 attestations (or SOC roadmap if still in progress), draft a focused data-flow diagram, and provide a scoped list of cloud services we run in production.

Can we target Thu 29 Mar for a short 30-min follow-up to review the roster and any blockers? I can make time in the morning PT.

Thanks —
Soojin
Soojin Lee
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

Attachments: redwood_security_profile.pdf (PDF, 420KB); sq_kickoff_template.docx (DOCX, 18KB)

From: Alex James <alex.james@medexus.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, security@medexus.com
Cc: 
Date: Fri, 23 Mar 2028 09:02:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-demo: third-party snapshot + security questionnaire (next steps)

Hi Soojin —

Appreciate the clear list. A couple clarifications from our side before we populate the roster:

- Can you confirm whether Redwood currently holds a SOC 2 Type II report? If not, what evidence can you provide in the interim (SOC readiness report, control matrix, penetration test results)?
- We need a short CSV with columns for: provider name, service purpose, region(s) where data is processed, whether PHI/PII is involved, point of contact, and any subcontracted providers. Can you send your preferred template?
- Data residency: Medexus requires controls to ensure EU patient data (when present) is not persisted outside EU regions unless encrypted at rest and with customer-managed keys. Do you support CMK and regional pinning today?
- HIPAA: we will need to understand which parts of the Redwood stack (e.g., embeddings, model runtime, logs) may ingest PHI so we can route those through our BAA scope; please flag components that would require a BAA.

Timeline from Security: we aim to have internal review completed within two weeks of receiving the CSV + DPA redlines. Legal will likely attach redlines to the DPA and push back on any broad subcontractor clauses.

I can fill the CSV template by Monday if you send it. We agree on Thu 29 Mar for a follow-up — morning ET works for us.

Thanks,
Alex James
Head of Information Security, Medexus Health
alex.james@medexus.com

---
Note: attaching an initial subprocessor list will speed things up — our procurement team prefers CSVs over PDFs for ingestion.

Karthik / Marissa —

Looping you both in. Alex has asked for: SOC 2 status, a CSV subprocessor roster with region + PHI flag, confirmation on CMK support, and which components would require a BAA. They target internal review two weeks after receiving materials.

Proposed owners:
- Karthik: pull SOC 2 artifacts (or readiness evidence), pen test summary, and write a one-paragraph status note we can share with Medexus.
- Marissa: produce the operational answer set (which runtime components touch tokens, logs retention, where embeddings are stored, current encryption/KMS posture).
- Me: package a short CSV of our vendors/cloud providers, plus a simple data-flow diagram.

I attached an internal checklist (internal-action-items.md) and the template CSV they requested. I can draft the DPA redline-friendly summary for Legal to start with.

Can you both confirm owners and whether the Thursday 29 Mar morning PT slot is still OK for a sync with Medexus?

Thanks —
Soojin

Attachments: internal-action-items.md; medexus_subprocessors_template.csv

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex James <alex.james@medexus.com>, security@medexus.com
Date: Mon, 26 Mar 2028 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Post-demo: third-party snapshot + security questionnaire (next steps)

Thanks — confirmation from my side:

- SOC 2: Redwood completed SOC 2 Type II in Nov 2027 for the inference platform. I will pull the SOC report and a 1-page control matrix (redacted where appropriate) and share by EOD Tue 28 Mar. If Medexus needs full reports under NDA, Legal can route that once we have an NDA in place.
- CMK / regional pinning: we support customer-managed keys via KMS integrations (AWS KMS / GCP KMS) for dedicated/private deployments today; hosted customers can request BYOK on a case-by-case basis — I'll include the exact configurations and limitations in the doc.
- BAA scope: core runtime (model serving, KV cache, embeddings store) can be in-scope for a BAA where PHI is processed. Logging and monitoring pipelines are configurable; we can provide options to redact or route logs out of retention windows. Marissa — can you confirm current default retention for request logs?
- Subprocessor roster: I'll assemble our production cloud providers + monitoring and analytics partners list into the CSV template.

I will attach: SOC2_redacted_summary.pdf; control_matrix_overview.csv; kms_cmk_notes.md. Planning to get this into the shared Drive link and ping Legal for the NDA/DPA routing.

Karthik
Head of Security Operations, Redwood Inference

Team —

Thanks for the quick turn. This looks good. We received the CSV template and will populate it by Mon 2 Apr at the latest. Our Legal will send DPA redlines as a DocuSign link — expect that in the next few days.

Confirmed: Thu 29 Mar morning PT is our follow-up slot — we propose 8:30am PT / 11:30am ET. If that still aligns with your calendars, I'll send a calendar invite. Agenda: quick walkthrough of roster, SOC 2 summary Q&A, and DPA next steps.

A couple of minor asks to cover in the call:
- Can you provide a one-slide summary of which components (runtime, embeddings, logs) are BYOK-capable vs managed?
- If SOC 2 contains any open mitigations from the last audit, we need a short note on timelines to close.

I'll send the calendar invite shortly.

Best,
Alex
Head of Information Security, Medexus Health
